objective: Measure phases and doubling rounds of the w-distinction law (with and without copies) on small random atom patterns at the jump, layered random circuits, ladders, pyramids and balanced trees, against frozen predictions.
status: Supported 2026-11-16 (refereed CARRY-STRANDS-R1, confirmed with fixes): frozen run of 305 cases, all gates held; 2 of 7 predictions held (Q3b, Q4) and 5 failed (Q1 at n = 4096 only, 30 fresh samples give 0.97; Q1b gain 0.104 > 0.10; Q2 rounds saved more, ratio 0.685..0.73; Q3 layered gains mostly zero; Q5 T3 = T2 = 13 at d = 4, l = 16, corrected after the referee). In the median sample keeping saves no phase before the narrowest phase (9 of 105 samples some, at most 4.1%), 6-12% after; spend-only w = 2 cuts rounds by 22-32%.
title: Phases and doubling rounds against the number of carried distinctions
